_comment: OPT-IN. Copy the 'hooks' block below into your project's .claude/settings.json to enable the gate. It refuses to let a session end while .gauntlet/state.json still says running — turning the win condition from a convention into a mechanism. Nothing in the plugin depends on it.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); printf %s "$in" | grep -q '"stop_hook_active": *true' && exit 0; [ -f .gauntlet/state.json ] && grep -q '"status": *"running"' .gauntlet/state.json && echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Gauntlet run is still active - the win condition (two consecutive blind wins by fresh critics) has not been met. Continue the loop, or set .gauntlet/state.json status to stopped if the user ended the run."}'; exit 0
